protocol: Pressurization loss during a functional check flight at FL300. The pilot reported that the cabin-altimeter indication reached 30000 ft. Pilot descended to FL200 and regained pressurization. Actual time above 25000 ft and gas delivery are unreported.
outcome_window: Symptoms began several hours postflight, persisted into the next day and were diagnosed by the flight surgeon. Hyperbaric treatment was given and no recurrence was reported.
locator: Printed pp. 24–26, Figures 1–4 and Flying Smart — Reporting Smart?
